oracle.expected: Inspection of terminal collection and execution status shows that any missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error condition affecting required cases produces a non-passing terminal outcome, while an expected negative fixture rejection remains a passing test case.
forbidden: A required case is missing while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is skipped while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is deselected while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is xfailed while the terminal selection passes.
The required case set executes zero cases while the terminal selection passes.
A harness error affects required cases while the terminal selection passes.
oracle.observable: The terminal pytest result and its collection, execution, and harness diagnostics are inspected against the required-case mapping.

acceptance.then: The terminal validation cannot pass when any listed missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error condition affects required cases.
acceptance.when: The repository-owned pytest terminal selection evaluates the required Package A cases and its collection, execution, and harness status are inspected for required-case integrity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the repository-owned terminal pytest selector and verify that missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error conditions affecting required Package A cases prevent a passing terminal result; use the existing execution-plans/2026-08-06-skill-authoring-standard/tools/tests/test_validate_implementation.py selector and the source-required planned Package A selector when authored.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Package A terminal validation fail closed when required-case collection, execution, or harness integrity is violated.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; rollback restores the prior terminal predicate without changing persisted state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Required-case terminal validation transitions from pass-eligible to blocked or failing whenever a required-case integrity or harness condition is observed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The repository-owned pytest terminal command exits non-zero or is prevented from passing whenever a required Package A case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, executes zero cases, or is affected by a harness error.
